text:
mike-sales: FYI — FinServ prospect wants a POC with BYO-KMS + HSM proxy. They care about latency (<30ms p95), key rotation policy, and attestation. Can ops + security weigh in?

alejandra-eng: Great — are they asking for cloudHSM or a customer HSM behind our proxy?

mike-sales: Customer-managed HSM in their VPC. They want our inference endpoints to call out to their keystore for envelope keys.

lucy-solutions: Ok. Typical flow: app -> redwood proxy -> fetch KEK from customer HSM -> unwrap locally. They want an HA path and cutover plan.

raj-security: Need answers for the security questionnaire: 1) key material never stored in plaintext on our side; 2) TLS mutual auth to keystore; 3) rotation/split-key support. Also request HSM attestation report (quote: "provides HSM vendor/serial and firmware version").

kevin-sre: Latency note: calling a remote HSM per-request will add ~10–40ms depending on region. We should push for an envelope-key caching TTL and enforced KV cache invalidation on rotation.

mike-sales: They asked if we can do short-lived envelope keys and cache them for 1 minute — acceptable?

alejandra-eng: 1 minute TTL is fine. We'll add automatic invalidation when rotation event fires. Need SOW to include rotation window and fail-open semantics.

lucy-solutions: Pricing question from buyer: do we bill extra for HSM proxy egress calls or fold into Dedicated throughput?

mike-sales: They prefer predictable monthly committed cost. Can finance/ops give a quote for a reserved egress + operations add-on?

presto-bot: Uploaded: https://files.redwood.dev/sow-examples/byok-proxy-draft-v1.pdf

raj-security: Review SOW draft for: (a) explicit non-persistence of key material, (b) audit log retention, (c) KMS rotation notification webhook to customer, and (d) attestation exchange cadence.

kevin-sre: Ops checklist: firewall rules (egress to customer HSM IPs), mutual TLS cert pair, retry/backoff for transient errors, and canary before wide rollout. Sample iptables/cidr listed in SOW.

lucy-solutions: Also capture failure modes: if HSM unreachable, fallback to a lower-cost local cached KEK with strict TTL and circuit-breaker. Document acceptance criteria in POC: throughput >= 80% baseline, p95 latency <30ms, and rotation leak test pass.

mike-sales: Action items: Alejandra to update SOW with rotation and cache semantics; Raj to draft security questionnaire answers and request attestation; Kevin to produce a short latency/throughput impact note and firewall rules snippet; Lucy to own the POC acceptance criteria. I'll follow up with buyer re: budget band.

alejandra-eng: I can get SOW v1 out by EOD tomorrow.

raj-security: I'll start the questionnaire answers now — throwing the attestation request to their infosec contact.

kevin-sre: I'll run a quick test plan and share numbers by tomorrow noon.

mike-sales: Perfect — keeping this thread pinned to the deal channel. :thumbsup:

lucy-solutions: One more ask from them: key rotation frequency must be configurable up to hourly. We should call out implications (higher HSM calls, cost).

alejandra-eng: Noted — will include an appendix that lists perf/cost tradeoffs for rotation windows (hourly/6hr/daily).

mike-sales: Thanks team — any blockers now?

raj-security: Blocker: need legal signoff on attestation exchange language (I flagged contract team).

mike-sales: Ok. I'll escalate to AM and legal.

kevin-sre: No infra blockers from my side.

lucy-solutions: No blockers; will start drafting the acceptance test harness.

mike-sales: Closing loop — target POC kickoff call scheduled 2 days from now. I'll share calendar invite after SOW v1 lands. :spiral_calendar:
